primary_contract: 2026-27 source inventory, pricing constants API, and conservative validation-status documentation
description: Add IHACPA 2026-27 NEP, technical specification, price-weight, and calculator coverage support.

support_scope.summary: Covers 2026-27 source inventory, NEP26/NEC26 pricing constants, classification-version metadata, source checksums, and conservative validation-status documentation. It does not claim calculator parity.

gap_register.summary: Calculator parity is not proven against official IHACPA SAS or Excel outputs.
The SAS .7Z archive is retained as raw evidence but has not been extracted or internally enumerated.
Excel .xlsb workbooks are raw, unmodified evidence and have not been internally audited for formulas or worksheet structure.
HAC and AHR companion technical-specification checksums are deferred until a safety-and-quality follow-on track expands those claims.
